strings.scene.liaojin.abaoji.title: 契丹建国
strings.scene.liaojin.abaoji.subtitle: 耶律阿保机
strings.vo.01: 唐朝灭亡的那一年，北方草原上的契丹迭剌部首领耶律阿保机被推为可汗。
strings.vo.02: 契丹旧俗，可汗三年一代。阿保机却不肯交出大位，他的几个弟弟先后三次起兵作乱，都被他平定。
strings.vo.03: 神册元年，阿保机正式称帝，立长子耶律倍为皇太子。此后又命人创制契丹大字。
strings.vo.04: 他的妻子述律平同他一起处理军国大事，契丹人称她为地皇后。
strings.vo.05: 晚年，阿保机说：我还有一件事未了——
strings.scene.liaojin.abaoji.quote: 所谓两事，一事已毕，惟渤海世仇未雪
strings.scene.liaojin.abaoji.fork.prompt: 契丹建国——依《辽史》直书，还是听异说「盐池宴」？
strings.scene.liaojin.abaoji.canon.intro: 潢河岸边的草地上，八部的大人们围成一圈。按旧俗，今天要推举新的可汗。
strings.scene.liaojin.abaoji.end.canon: 天显元年正月，渤海王大諲譔出降，阿保机改渤海为东丹国，以耶律倍为东丹王。七月，阿保机在回师途中病卒于扶余府。述律后欲以身殉，被劝止，乃断右腕纳于柩中。
strings.scene.liaojin.abaoji.legend.disclaimer: 以下取欧阳修《新五代史·四夷附录》所载，并参照蔡东藩《五代史演义》第十一回。《新五代史》说阿保机以盐池之利召诸部大人赴宴，伏兵尽杀之，遂并八部；《辽史》不载此事，两说并存。
strings.scene.liaojin.abaoji.legend.intro: 《新五代史》说：阿保机不肯交出可汗之位，诸部共同责备他。他便自立于汉城，那里有盐池，诸部吃的盐都从这里出。
strings.scene.liaojin.abaoji.end.legend: 盐池宴的血与《辽史》里的推举，最后都通往同一个皇帝。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

narration: 唐朝灭亡的那一年，北方草原上的契丹迭剌部首领耶律阿保机被推为可汗。
契丹旧俗，可汗三年一代。阿保机却不肯交出大位，他的几个弟弟先后三次起兵作乱，都被他平定。
神册元年，阿保机正式称帝，立长子耶律倍为皇太子。此后又命人创制契丹大字。
他的妻子述律平同他一起处理军国大事，契丹人称她为地皇后。
晚年，阿保机说：我还有一件事未了——
天显元年正月，渤海王大諲譔出降，阿保机改渤海为东丹国，以耶律倍为东丹王。七月，阿保机在回师途中病卒于扶余府。
所谓两事，一事已毕，惟渤海世仇未雪

镜头 4（30–38 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：耶律阿保机、述律平、旌旗｜动作：龙化州，阿保机称天皇帝｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：青铜钟声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他的妻子述律平同他一起处理军国大事，契丹人称她为地皇后。」
镜头 5（38–44 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：主体：军阵、长兵如林、盾墙；飞白题字「雪」「渤海」｜动作：东征渤海，忽汗城出降｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；枯笔竖线密如森林；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：号角、喊杀｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「晚年，阿保机说：我还有一件事未了——」
镜头 6（44–57 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：天显元年正月，渤海王大諲譔出降，阿保机改渤海为东丹国，以耶律倍为东丹王。七月，阿保机在回师途中病卒于扶余府。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「天显元年正月，渤海王大諲譔出降，阿保机改渤海为东丹国，以耶律倍为东丹王。七月，阿保机在回师途中病卒于扶余府。」
镜头 7（57–63 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「所谓两事，一事已毕，惟渤海世仇未雪」，下署《辽史·太祖纪下》；右下角朱印「天皇」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「所谓两事，一事已毕，惟渤海世仇未雪」

声音：背景乐：胡笳，边塞悲凉，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：草原风、人群低语、远处厮杀声、宫殿回响；音效：号角、马蹄声、青铜钟声、喊杀；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：片头：右上竖排书法片名「契丹建国」，副题「耶律阿保机」，朱印「天皇」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「所谓两事，一事已毕，惟渤海世仇未雪」——《辽史·太祖纪下》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，复杂五官，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Liao, Western Xia and Jin (907–1234) · Founding the Khitan State: Yelü Abaoji (「契丹建国」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 63 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Setting: Liao, Western Xia and Jin (907–1234), 916 CE — steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields.

Characters:
- Yelü Abaoji (耶律阿保机) — ruler, Khitan; Khitan dress: shaved crown, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, leather boots; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Shu Lüping (述律平) — royal / consort, Khitan; Khitan dress: shaved crown, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, leather boots; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Yelü Lage (耶律剌葛) — royal / consort, Khitan; Khitan dress: shaved crown, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, leather boots; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Yelü Bei (耶律倍) — royal / consort, Khitan; Khitan dress: shaved crown, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, leather boots; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Da Yinzhuan (大諲譔) — ruler, Bohai; Khitan shaved-crown hairstyles, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robes and leather boots, Tangut shaved heads, Jurchen braids; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–9 s, 9 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: grass, river, army tents | Action: Tents of the eight Khitan tribes by the Huang River | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: steppe wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「契丹建国」 with vermilion seal 「天皇」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「唐朝灭亡的那一年，北方草原上的契丹迭剌部首领耶律阿保机被推为可汗。」
Shot 2 (9–20 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Yelü Abaoji, crowd, banners | Action: The chiefs elect Abaoji as khagan | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: horn | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「契丹旧俗，可汗三年一代。阿保机却不肯交出大位，他的几个弟弟先后三次起兵作乱，都被他平定。」
Shot 3 (20–30 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: grass; subject: Yelü Lage, cavalry | Action: His brothers plot three times; Abaoji pursues them himself | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; ink spatters where hooves strike; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「所谓两事，一事已毕，惟渤海世仇未雪」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「神册元年，阿保机正式称帝，立长子耶律倍为皇太子。此后又命人创制契丹大字。」
Shot 4 (30–38 s, 8 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Yelü Abaoji, Shu Lüping, banners | Action: At Longhua Abaoji proclaims himself Heavenly Emperor | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他的妻子述律平同他一起处理军国大事，契丹人称她为地皇后。」
Shot 5 (38–44 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: army ranks, forest of spears, shield wall; dry-brush calligraphy 「雪」「渤海」 | Action: Campaign east: Huhan city of Bohai surrenders | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: horn, war cries | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「晚年，阿保机说：我还有一件事未了——」
Shot 6 (44–57 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Bohai becomes the Dongdan kingdom; Abaoji dies on the way home, and Empress Shulü cuts off her right hand to place in his coffin. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「天显元年正月，渤海王大諲譔出降，阿保机改渤海为东丹国，以耶律倍为东丹王。七月，阿保机在回师途中病卒于扶余府。」
Shot 7 (57–63 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「所谓两事，一事已毕，惟渤海世仇未雪」 signed 《辽史·太祖纪下》; vermilion seal 「天皇」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「所谓两事，一事已毕，惟渤海世仇未雪」

Sound: Music: hujia reed pipe, bleak frontier mood, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: steppe wind, crowd murmur, distant battle, palace hall reverb; SFX: horn, hoofbeats, bronze bell, war cries; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「契丹建国」, subtitle 「耶律阿保机」, vermilion seal 「天皇」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「所谓两事，一事已毕，惟渤海世仇未雪」 — 《辽史·太祖纪下》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, detailed faces, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets

strings.scene.liaojin.xiaotaihou.title: 承天太后
strings.scene.liaojin.xiaotaihou.subtitle: 萧绰
strings.vo.01: 辽景宗在行宫病逝，遗诏梁王隆绪即位，军国大事听皇后之命。新皇帝只有十二岁。
strings.vo.02: 宗室诸王拥兵在外。皇后对耶律斜轸、韩德让哭道：母寡子弱，族属雄强，边防未靖，奈何？
strings.vo.03: 两人答：信任臣等，何虑之有！
strings.vo.04: 四年之后，宋太宗趁辽主年幼，三路北伐。太后与圣宗亲临前线督战。
strings.scene.liaojin.xiaotaihou.quote: 母寡子弱，族属雄强，边防未靖
strings.scene.liaojin.xiaotaihou.fork.prompt: 承天太后——依《辽史》直书，还是听演义「杨家将」？
strings.scene.liaojin.xiaotaihou.canon.intro: 乾亨四年九月，焦山行宫。景宗刚刚咽气，帐外的诸王还不知道消息。皇后召来了耶律斜轸与韩德让。
strings.scene.liaojin.xiaotaihou.end.canon: 澶渊之盟后，宋辽百余年间大体无战事。统和二十七年，太后归政于圣宗，同年十二月病逝。《辽史》称辽之所以兴盛，太后的辅佐之功居多。
strings.scene.liaojin.xiaotaihou.legend.disclaim: 以下取明代小说《杨家府世代忠勇通俗演义》与蔡东藩《宋史演义》第二十三回。小说戏曲中的萧太后，是与杨家将对阵的敌国太后，形象多为附会；正史中她是辽代杰出的摄政者。
strings.scene.liaojin.xiaotaihou.legend.intro: 小说里，萧太后坐镇幽州，用计困住杨家将，又在澶州城下与宋朝君臣斗智。
strings.scene.liaojin.xiaotaihou.end.legend: 小说里的敌国太后与正史里的摄政者，在澶州城下签下同一纸盟约。
strings.scene.liaojin.xiaotaihou.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若澶州一战辽军得胜（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 辽 · 西夏 · 金 · 乾亨四年九月（982 年九月）。草原毡帐、捺钵营地、城塞、雪原。
setting.en: Liao, Western Xia and Jin (907–1234), 982 CE — steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields.

shots.vo: 辽景宗在行宫病逝，遗诏梁王隆绪即位，军国大事听皇后之命。新皇帝只有十二岁。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–10 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：营帐、近山与地面｜动作：景宗崩于云州焦山行宫｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白｜声音：环境：草原风；音效：青铜钟声｜屏幕文字：片名「承天太后」竖排书法与朱印「承天」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「辽景宗在行宫病逝，遗诏梁王隆绪即位，军国大事听皇后之命。新皇帝只有十二岁。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: army tents, near hills and ground | Action: Emperor Jingzong dies at a travelling palace | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「承天太后」 with vermilion seal 「承天」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「辽景宗在行宫病逝，遗诏梁王隆绪即位，军国大事听皇后之命。新皇帝只有十二岁。」

shots.vo: 宗室诸王拥兵在外。皇后对耶律斜轸、韩德让哭道：母寡子弱，族属雄强，边防未靖，奈何？
shots.zh: 镜头 2（10–20 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：萧绰、韩德让｜动作：太后泣曰：母寡子弱｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「宗室诸王拥兵在外。皇后对耶律斜轸、韩德让哭道：母寡子弱，族属雄强，边防未靖，奈何？」
shots.en: Shot 2 (10–20 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Xiao Chuo, Han Derang | Action: The dowager weeps: a widowed mother and a young son | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宗室诸王拥兵在外。皇后对耶律斜轸、韩德让哭道：母寡子弱，族属雄强，边防未靖，奈何？」

shots.vo: 两人答：信任臣等，何虑之有！
shots.zh: 镜头 3（20–26 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：地图卷；主体：军阵、长兵如林、旌旗｜动作：统和四年，宋军三路北伐｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；枯笔竖线密如森林｜声音：环境：军营鼓声；音效：号角｜屏幕文字：引文「母寡子弱，族属雄强，边防未靖」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「两人答：信任臣等，何虑之有！」
shots.en: Shot 3 (20–26 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: map scroll; subject: army ranks, forest of spears, banners | Action: In 986 Song invades on three fronts | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: horn | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「母寡子弱，族属雄强，边防未靖」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「两人答：信任臣等，何虑之有！」

shots.vo: 四年之后，宋太宗趁辽主年幼，三路北伐。太后与圣宗亲临前线督战。

宗室诸王拥兵在外。皇后对耶律斜轸、韩德让哭道：母寡子弱，族属雄强，边防未靖，奈何？

strings.scene.liaojin.yuanhao.title: 蕃书
strings.scene.liaojin.yuanhao.subtitle: 元昊称帝
strings.vo.01: 党项首领李德明臣事宋朝，每年接受宋朝赏赐的锦绮。他的儿子元昊却劝他：穿皮毛、事畜牧，才是蕃人习惯的生活。
strings.vo.02: 元昊说：英雄生在世上，应当称王称霸，要这些锦绮做什么！
strings.vo.03: 父亲死后元昊继位。他先剃去自己的头发，下令国人在三日之内一律秃发，不从者许众人杀之。
strings.vo.04: 他又自制蕃书，命大臣野利仁荣演绎，成十二卷。字形方整，笔画繁复，看起来像汉字，却一个也不认得。
strings.vo.05: 宝元元年十月，兴庆府南郊——
strings.scene.liaojin.yuanhao.quote: 英雄之生，当王霸耳，何锦绮为！
strings.scene.liaojin.yuanhao.fork.prompt: 蕃书——依《宋史》直书，还是听演义《宋史演义》？
strings.scene.liaojin.yuanhao.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《宋史·夏国传》所载
strings.scene.liaojin.yuanhao.canon.intro: 一个政权要立起来，先要和旁人不一样：不一样的头发，不一样的文字，不一样的年号。
strings.scene.liaojin.yuanhao.end.canon: 元昊称帝，国号大夏，次年遣使上表宋朝，要求承认。宋朝削其官爵，悬赏捉拿，宋夏之间爆发了三川口、好水川、定川寨三场大战。西夏文字一直使用到明代中期。
strings.scene.liaojin.yuanhao.legend.disclaimer: 以下取蔡东藩《宋史演义》第二十八回“萧耨斤挟权弑主母 赵元昊僭号寇边疆”对元昊称帝前后的敷演，小说称元昊为“赵元昊”（因其曾受宋赐姓赵）。另附黑水城出土西夏文献的发现：一九〇九年俄国科兹洛夫在黑水城掘得大量西夏文书，这是后世“重新认识”西夏文字的开始。
strings.scene.liaojin.yuanhao.legend.intro: 演义里，元昊登坛之日，风沙大作，贺兰山下的旗帜被吹得猎猎作响。几百年后，一位外国探险家在沙漠里挖出了一屋子没人认得的书。
strings.scene.liaojin.yuanhao.end.legend: 演义写的是登坛，考古找回的是文字。西夏亡了，西夏文又被读懂了。
strings.scene.liaojin.yuanhao.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若宋夏议和于称帝前（未开放）

黑白红武侠水墨剪影素材图（场景环境），题材：蕃书·元昊称帝（1038 年十月）。
画风：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）——大块黑色剪影与平涂灰阶，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白；少纹理、少装饰；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：4×3 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 远山（淡墨）；2. 近坡（中墨）；3. 土坡地线；4. 草丛（枯笔）。
第 2 行：5. 书案；6. 宣纸卷轴；7. 笔架与砚台；8. 屏风。
第 3 行：9. 城墙雉堞；10. 殿柱；11. 屋檐；12. 留空。
排版参考尺寸：2048×1536 像素，每格按 512×512 切分；实际生成尺寸以所用服务返回值为准，裁切前须确认比例与透明通道。只有墨线与墨块，不加任何文字、书法、印章、边框、网格线、水印。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 辽 · 西夏 · 金 · 宋宝元元年，夏天授礼法延祚元年（1038 年十月）。草原毡帐、捺钵营地、城塞、雪原。
setting.en: Liao, Western Xia and Jin (907–1234), 1038 CE — steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields.

characters.name: 李元昊
characters.zh: 李元昊（西夏·夏景宗）：党项装束：秃发、圆领窄袖袍、毡冠；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；通蕃汉文字，秃发、制蕃书，称帝建大夏
characters.en: Li Yuanhao (李元昊) — ruler, Western Xia; Tangut dress: shaved head, round-collar narrow-sleeved robe, felt crown; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 野利仁荣
characters.zh: 野利仁荣（西夏·西夏文臣）：党项装束：秃发、圆领窄袖袍、毡冠；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；奉命演绎蕃书，成十二卷
characters.en: Ye Lirenrong (野利仁荣) — scholar, Western Xia; Tangut dress: shaved head, round-collar narrow-sleeved robe, felt crown; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 李德明
characters.zh: 李德明（西夏·元昊之父）：党项装束：秃发、圆领窄袖袍、毡冠；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；臣事宋朝，受宋锦绮
characters.en: Li Deming (李德明) — ruler, Western Xia; Tangut dress: shaved head, round-collar narrow-sleeved robe, felt crown; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 宋朝使臣
characters.zh: 宋朝使臣（北宋·北宋）：契丹髡发、左衽窄袖袍与皮靴；党项秃发；女真辫发；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；接到元昊称帝的表章
characters.en: Song Chaoshichen (宋朝使臣) — minister, Beisong; Khitan shaved-crown hairstyles, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robes and leather boots, Tangut shaved heads, Jurchen braids; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 党项首领李德明臣事宋朝，每年接受宋朝赏赐的锦绮。他的儿子元昊却劝他：穿皮毛、事畜牧，才是蕃人习惯的生活。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–13 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面；主体：李元昊、骑兵｜动作：贺兰山下，一个少年骑在马上，不肯穿锦衣｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：片名「蕃书」竖排书法与朱印「大夏」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「党项首领李德明臣事宋朝，每年接受宋朝赏赐的锦绮。他的儿子元昊却劝他：穿皮毛、事畜牧，才是蕃人习惯的生活。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–13 s, 13 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground; subject: Li Yuanhao, cavalry | Action: A boy at the foot of the Helan mountains refuses brocade clothes | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; ink spatters where hooves strike; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「蕃书」 with vermilion seal 「大夏」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「党项首领李德明臣事宋朝，每年接受宋朝赏赐的锦绮。他的儿子元昊却劝他：穿皮毛、事畜牧，才是蕃人习惯的生活。」

shots.vo: 元昊说：英雄生在世上，应当称王称霸，要这些锦绮做什么！
shots.zh: 镜头 2（13–21 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：秃发；主体：李元昊、众人｜动作：他先剃去自己的头发，下令三日之内全国照做｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：人群低语；音效：刀声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「元昊说：英雄生在世上，应当称王称霸，要这些锦绮做什么！」
shots.en: Shot 2 (13–21 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: 秃发; subject: Li Yuanhao, crowd | Action: He shaves his own head and orders the whole country to follow within three days | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: blade | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「元昊说：英雄生在世上，应当称王称霸，要这些锦绮做什么！」

shots.vo: 父亲死后元昊继位。他先剃去自己的头发，下令国人在三日之内一律秃发，不从者许众人杀之。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（21–32 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：蕃书、卷轴；主体：野利仁荣｜动作：文臣把汉字拆开，一笔一画地重新组合｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：引文「英雄之生，当王霸耳，何锦绮为！」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「父亲死后元昊继位。他先剃去自己的头发，下令国人在三日之内一律秃发，不从者许众人杀之。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (21–32 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: 蕃书, scroll; subject: Ye Lirenrong | Action: Scholars break Chinese characters apart and recombine them stroke by stroke | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「英雄之生，当王霸耳，何锦绮为！」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「父亲死后元昊继位。他先剃去自己的头发，下令国人在三日之内一律秃发，不从者许众人杀之。」

shots.vo: 他又自制蕃书，命大臣野利仁荣演绎，成十二卷。字形方整，笔画繁复，看起来像汉字，却一个也不认得。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（32–43 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞、殿柱、屋檐；主体：旌旗｜动作：兴庆府南郊，筑起高台｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：众人呐喊；音效：战鼓｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他又自制蕃书，命大臣野利仁荣演绎，成十二卷。字形方整，笔画繁复，看起来像汉字，却一个也不认得。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (32–43 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall, palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: banners | Action: A high platform is built south of Xingqing | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; scorched-ink outline of battlements; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: roaring crowd; SFX: war drums | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他又自制蕃书，命大臣野利仁荣演绎，成十二卷。字形方整，笔画繁复，看起来像汉字，却一个也不认得。」

shots.vo: 宝元元年十月，兴庆府南郊——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（43–49 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：大夏；主体：李元昊、旌旗；飞白题字「大夏」｜动作：他受册登台，宣读用新文字写成的册文｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：青铜钟声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「宝元元年十月，兴庆府南郊——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (43–49 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: 大夏; subject: Li Yuanhao, banners; dry-brush calligraphy 「大夏」 | Action: He mounts the platform and reads a proclamation in the new script | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宝元元年十月，兴庆府南郊——」

shots.vo: 元昊称帝，国号大夏，次年遣使上表宋朝，要求承认。宋朝削其官爵，悬赏捉拿，宋夏之间爆发了三川口、好水川、定川寨三场大战。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（49–63 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：李元昊｜动作：正史结局：元昊称帝，国号大夏，次年遣使上表宋朝，要求承认。宋朝削其官爵，悬赏捉拿，宋夏之间爆发了三川口、好水川、定川寨三场大战。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「元昊称帝，国号大夏，次年遣使上表宋朝，要求承认。宋朝削其官爵，悬赏捉拿，宋夏之间爆发了三川口、好水川、定川寨三场大战。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (49–63 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Li Yuanhao | Action: Canonical outcome: Yuanhao founds the Great Xia; Song refuses recognition and three major battles follow, while the Tangut script survives into the Ming. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「元昊称帝，国号大夏，次年遣使上表宋朝，要求承认。宋朝削其官爵，悬赏捉拿，宋夏之间爆发了三川口、好水川、定川寨三场大战。」

shots.vo: 英雄之生，当王霸耳，何锦绮为！
shots.zh: 镜头 7（63–69 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「英雄之生，当王霸耳，何锦绮为！」，下署《宋史·夏国传上》；右下角朱印「大夏」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「英雄之生，当王霸耳，何锦绮为！」
shots.en: Shot 7 (63–69 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「英雄之生，当王霸耳，何锦绮为！」 signed 《宋史·夏国传上》; vermilion seal 「大夏」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「英雄之生，当王霸耳，何锦绮为！」

narration: 党项首领李德明臣事宋朝，每年接受宋朝赏赐的锦绮。他的儿子元昊却劝他：穿皮毛、事畜牧，才是蕃人习惯的生活。
元昊说：英雄生在世上，应当称王称霸，要这些锦绮做什么！
父亲死后元昊继位。他先剃去自己的头发，下令国人在三日之内一律秃发，不从者许众人杀之。
他又自制蕃书，命大臣野利仁荣演绎，成十二卷。字形方整，笔画繁复，看起来像汉字，却一个也不认得。
宝元元年十月，兴庆府南郊——
元昊称帝，国号大夏，次年遣使上表宋朝，要求承认。宋朝削其官爵，悬赏捉拿，宋夏之间爆发了三川口、好水川、定川寨三场大战。
英雄之生，当王霸耳，何锦绮为！

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 69 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

时代与场景：辽 · 西夏 · 金 · 宋宝元元年，夏天授礼法延祚元年（1038 年十月）。草原毡帐、捺钵营地、城塞、雪原。

人物：
- 李元昊（西夏·夏景宗）：党项装束：秃发、圆领窄袖袍、毡冠；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；通蕃汉文字，秃发、制蕃书，称帝建大夏
- 野利仁荣（西夏·西夏文臣）：党项装束：秃发、圆领窄袖袍、毡冠；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；奉命演绎蕃书，成十二卷
- 李德明（西夏·元昊之父）：党项装束：秃发、圆领窄袖袍、毡冠；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；臣事宋朝，受宋锦绮
- 宋朝使臣（北宋·北宋）：契丹髡发、左衽窄袖袍与皮靴；党项秃发；女真辫发；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；接到元昊称帝的表章

镜头 2（13–21 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：秃发；主体：李元昊、众人｜动作：他先剃去自己的头发，下令三日之内全国照做｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：人群低语；音效：刀声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「元昊说：英雄生在世上，应当称王称霸，要这些锦绮做什么！」
镜头 3（21–32 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：蕃书、卷轴；主体：野利仁荣｜动作：文臣把汉字拆开，一笔一画地重新组合｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：引文「英雄之生，当王霸耳，何锦绮为！」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「父亲死后元昊继位。他先剃去自己的头发，下令国人在三日之内一律秃发，不从者许众人杀之。」
镜头 4（32–43 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞、殿柱、屋檐；主体：旌旗｜动作：兴庆府南郊，筑起高台｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：众人呐喊；音效：战鼓｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他又自制蕃书，命大臣野利仁荣演绎，成十二卷。字形方整，笔画繁复，看起来像汉字，却一个也不认得。」
镜头 5（43–49 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：大夏；主体：李元昊、旌旗；飞白题字「大夏」｜动作：他受册登台，宣读用新文字写成的册文｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：青铜钟声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「宝元元年十月，兴庆府南郊——」
镜头 6（49–63 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：李元昊｜动作：正史结局：元昊称帝，国号大夏，次年遣使上表宋朝，要求承认。宋朝削其官爵，悬赏捉拿，宋夏之间爆发了三川口、好水川、定川寨三场大战。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「元昊称帝，国号大夏，次年遣使上表宋朝，要求承认。宋朝削其官爵，悬赏捉拿，宋夏之间爆发了三川口、好水川、定川寨三场大战。」

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Liao, Western Xia and Jin (907–1234) · The Tangut Script: Yuanhao Declares Himself Emperor (「蕃书」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 69 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Setting: Liao, Western Xia and Jin (907–1234), 1038 CE — steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields.

Characters:
- Li Yuanhao (李元昊) — ruler, Western Xia; Tangut dress: shaved head, round-collar narrow-sleeved robe, felt crown; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Ye Lirenrong (野利仁荣) — scholar, Western Xia; Tangut dress: shaved head, round-collar narrow-sleeved robe, felt crown; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Li Deming (李德明) — ruler, Western Xia; Tangut dress: shaved head, round-collar narrow-sleeved robe, felt crown; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Song Chaoshichen (宋朝使臣) — minister, Beisong; Khitan shaved-crown hairstyles, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robes and leather boots, Tangut shaved heads, Jurchen braids; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

strings.scene.liaojin.xiaoguanyin.title: 十香词
strings.scene.liaojin.xiaoguanyin.subtitle: 萧观音
strings.vo.01: 辽道宗的皇后萧观音美丽而有才学，能诗，善弹琵琶。道宗好猎，常年骑马出入山林，皇后上书劝谏，渐渐失宠。
strings.vo.02: 她写了十首《回心院》词，盼望皇帝回心转意，让伶官赵惟一谱曲演奏。
strings.vo.03: 北院枢密使耶律乙辛与皇后、太子不和。他让人写了一组艳词《十香词》，托宫婢单登请皇后亲笔抄写。
strings.vo.04: 乙辛拿着皇后的手迹，诬告她与赵惟一私通。道宗大怒，命乙辛审理此案。
strings.vo.05: 案子很快定了。大康元年十一月——
strings.scene.liaojin.xiaoguanyin.quote: 扫深殿，闭久金铺暗。游丝络网尘作堆，积岁青苔厚阶面。
strings.scene.liaojin.xiaoguanyin.fork.prompt: 十香词——依《辽史》直书，还是听笔记《焚椒录》？
strings.anchor.huixinyuan: 萧观音作《回心院》词，望道宗回心
strings.anchor.cisi: 宣懿皇后被诬与伶官赵惟一私通，赐自尽
strings.scene.liaojin.xiaoguanyin.canon.intro: 一位会写词的皇后，写了十首词盼丈夫回来。另一组十首词，要了她的命。
strings.scene.liaojin.xiaoguanyin.end.canon: 道宗赐皇后自尽，赵惟一被族诛。两年后，耶律乙辛又诬陷太子耶律濬谋反，太子被废后遭杀害。直到道宗晚年乙辛的奸谋败露，后来天祚帝即位，才为宣懿皇后追复名号。
strings.scene.liaojin.xiaoguanyin.legend.disclai: 以下取辽人王鼎《焚椒录》：作者自称得之于亲见者，详记《十香词》的来历与皇后临终所作《绝命辞》。此书是辽代存世的少数私人著述之一，所记细节《辽史》多未采。
strings.scene.liaojin.xiaoguanyin.legend.intro: 焚椒录里说，皇后临死前，向皇帝请求再见一面，没有得到允许。
strings.scene.liaojin.xiaoguanyin.end.legend: 焚椒录说，皇后望着帝所在的方向，作《绝命辞》后自尽。这本书让一桩冤案在正史之外留下了另一份证词。
strings.scene.liaojin.xiaoguanyin.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若道宗不信（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 辽 · 西夏 · 金 · 辽道宗大康元年（1075 年十一月）。草原毡帐、捺钵营地、城塞、雪原。
setting.en: Liao, Western Xia and Jin (907–1234), 1075 CE — steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields.

characters.name: 萧观音

characters.en: Xiao Guanyin (萧观音) — royal / consort, Liao (Khitan); Khitan dress: shaved crown, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, leather boots; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 辽道宗的皇后萧观音美丽而有才学，能诗，善弹琵琶。道宗好猎，常年骑马出入山林，皇后上书劝谏，渐渐失宠。

shots.en: Shot 1 (0–12 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: grass, army tents; subject: Liao Daozong, Xiao Guanyin, cavalry | Action: Outside the great autumn hunting tent the emperor rides off in pursuit of game while the empress stands before the tent | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; ink spatters where hooves strike; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「十香词」 with vermilion seal 「十香」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「辽道宗的皇后萧观音美丽而有才学，能诗，善弹琵琶。道宗好猎，常年骑马出入山林，皇后上书劝谏，渐渐失宠。」

shots.vo: 她写了十首《回心院》词，盼望皇帝回心转意，让伶官赵惟一谱曲演奏。

shots.en: Shot 2 (12–21 s, 9 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Xiao Guanyin | Action: In a lonely palace courtyard she holds her pipa and writes ten songs, "Return to the Heart Court" | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: pipa phrase | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「她写了十首《回心院》词，盼望皇帝回心转意，让伶官赵惟一谱曲演奏。」

shots.vo: 乙辛拿着皇后的手迹，诬告她与赵惟一私通。道宗大怒，命乙辛审理此案。

shots.en: Shot 7 (59–65 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「扫深殿，闭久金铺暗。游丝络网尘作堆，积岁青苔厚阶面。」 signed 《焚椒录·回心院词》; vermilion seal 「十香」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「扫深殿，闭久金铺暗。游丝络网尘作堆，积岁青苔厚阶面。」

sound.zh: 背景乐：琵琶，铿锵急切或婉转低回，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：草原风、寂静室内、宫殿回响；音效：马蹄声、琵琶一声、衣袂摩挲、静默、弦断；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: pipa lute, tense tremolo or wistful phrases, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: steppe wind, quiet room tone, palace hall reverb; SFX: hoofbeats, pipa phrase, rustling silk, silence, snapping string; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】辽 · 西夏 · 金 · 十香词（萧观音）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 65 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

时代与场景：辽 · 西夏 · 金 · 辽道宗大康元年（1075 年十一月）。草原毡帐、捺钵营地、城塞、雪原。

人物：
- 萧观音（辽·辽道宗宣懿皇后）：契丹装束：髡发、左衽窄袖袍、皮靴；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；工诗善琵琶，被诬以《十香词》赐死
- 辽道宗（辽·耶律洪基）：契丹装束：髡发、左衽窄袖袍、皮靴；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；听信谗言，赐皇后自尽
- 耶律乙辛（辽·北院枢密使）：契丹装束：髡发、左衽窄袖袍、皮靴；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；构陷皇后与太子
- 赵惟一（辽·伶官）：契丹装束：髡发、左衽窄袖袍、皮靴；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；被诬与皇后私通，族诛

分镜：
镜头 1（0–12 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：草、营帐；主体：辽道宗、萧观音、骑兵｜动作：秋捺钵的大帐外，皇帝骑马远去追猎，皇后站在帐前｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：草原风；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：片名「十香词」竖排书法与朱印「十香」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「辽道宗的皇后萧观音美丽而有才学，能诗，善弹琵琶。道宗好猎，常年骑马出入山林，皇后上书劝谏，渐渐失宠。」
镜头 2（12–21 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：萧观音｜动作：冷清的宫院里，她抱着琵琶，写下《回心院》十首｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：琵琶一声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「她写了十首《回心院》词，盼望皇帝回心转意，让伶官赵惟一谱曲演奏。」

镜头 4（33–42 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：辽道宗｜动作：皇帝看着纸上的字，那正是皇后的笔迹｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「乙辛拿着皇后的手迹，诬告她与赵惟一私通。道宗大怒，命乙辛审理此案。」
镜头 5（42–48 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：萧观音；飞白题字「十香」｜动作：白练垂下，琵琶的弦断了｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：弦断｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「案子很快定了。大康元年十一月——」
镜头 6（48–59 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：萧观音｜动作：正史结局：道宗赐皇后自尽，赵惟一被族诛。两年后，耶律乙辛又诬陷太子耶律濬谋反，太子被废后遭杀害。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「道宗赐皇后自尽，赵惟一被族诛。两年后，耶律乙辛又诬陷太子耶律濬谋反，太子被废后遭杀害。」
镜头 7（59–65 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「扫深殿，闭久金铺暗。游丝络网尘作堆，积岁青苔厚阶面。」，下署《焚椒录·回心院词》；右下角朱印「十香」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「扫深殿，闭久金铺暗。游丝络网尘作堆，积岁青苔厚阶面。」

声音：背景乐：琵琶，铿锵急切或婉转低回，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：草原风、寂静室内、宫殿回响；音效：马蹄声、琵琶一声、衣袂摩挲、静默、弦断；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：片头：右上竖排书法片名「十香词」，副题「萧观音」，朱印「十香」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「扫深殿，闭久金铺暗。游丝络网尘作堆，积岁青苔厚阶面。」——《焚椒录·回心院词》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，复杂五官，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Liao, Western Xia and Jin (907–1234) · The Ten Fragrances: Empress Xiao Guanyin (「十香词」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 65 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Setting: Liao, Western Xia and Jin (907–1234), 1075 CE — steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields.

Characters:
- Xiao Guanyin (萧观音) — royal / consort, Liao (Khitan); Khitan dress: shaved crown, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, leather boots; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Liao Daozong (辽道宗) — ruler, Liao (Khitan); Khitan dress: shaved crown, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, leather boots; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Yelü Yixin (耶律乙辛) — minister, Liao (Khitan); Khitan dress: shaved crown, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, leather boots; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zhao Weiyi (赵惟一) — commoner, Liao (Khitan); Khitan dress: shaved crown, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, leather boots; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–12 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: grass, army tents; subject: Liao Daozong, Xiao Guanyin, cavalry | Action: Outside the great autumn hunting tent the emperor rides off in pursuit of game while the empress stands before the tent | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; ink spatters where hooves strike; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「十香词」 with vermilion seal 「十香」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「辽道宗的皇后萧观音美丽而有才学，能诗，善弹琵琶。道宗好猎，常年骑马出入山林，皇后上书劝谏，渐渐失宠。」
Shot 2 (12–21 s, 9 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Xiao Guanyin | Action: In a lonely palace courtyard she holds her pipa and writes ten songs, "Return to the Heart Court" | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: pipa phrase | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「她写了十首《回心院》词，盼望皇帝回心转意，让伶官赵惟一谱曲演奏。」
Shot 3 (21–33 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Yelü Yixin | Action: A palace maid hands a page of erotic verse to the privy councillor | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「扫深殿，闭久金铺暗。游丝络网尘作堆，积岁青苔厚阶面。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「北院枢密使耶律乙辛与皇后、太子不和。他让人写了一组艳词《十香词》，托宫婢单登请皇后亲笔抄写。」
Shot 4 (33–42 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Liao Daozong | Action: The emperor stares at the page: it is in the empress's own hand | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: silence | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「乙辛拿着皇后的手迹，诬告她与赵惟一私通。道宗大怒，命乙辛审理此案。」
Shot 5 (42–48 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Xiao Guanyin; dry-brush calligraphy 「十香」 | Action: A white silk cord hangs down and a pipa string snaps | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: snapping string | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「案子很快定了。大康元年十一月——」
Shot 6 (48–59 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Xiao Guanyin | Action: Canonical outcome: The empress is ordered to die and the musician's clan executed; two years later Yelü Yixin frames the crown prince too, and only under Tianzuo is the empress posthumously restored. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「道宗赐皇后自尽，赵惟一被族诛。两年后，耶律乙辛又诬陷太子耶律濬谋反，太子被废后遭杀害。」
Shot 7 (59–65 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「扫深殿，闭久金铺暗。游丝络网尘作堆，积岁青苔厚阶面。」 signed 《焚椒录·回心院词》; vermilion seal 「十香」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「扫深殿，闭久金铺暗。游丝络网尘作堆，积岁青苔厚阶面。」

Sound: Music: pipa lute, tense tremolo or wistful phrases, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: steppe wind, quiet room tone, palace hall reverb; SFX: hoofbeats, pipa phrase, rustling silk, silence, snapping string; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「十香词」, subtitle 「萧观音」, vermilion seal 「十香」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「扫深殿，闭久金铺暗。游丝络网尘作堆，积岁青苔厚阶面。」 — 《焚椒录·回心院词》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, detailed faces, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets

strings.scene.liaojin.hubudagang.title: 护步答冈
strings.scene.liaojin.hubudagang.subtitle: 阿骨打起兵
strings.vo.01: 辽天庆二年春，天祚帝在混同江钓鱼，设头鱼宴，令女真诸部酋长依次起舞。
strings.vo.02: 阿骨打端坐不动，推辞不能。天祚帝欲杀之，被近臣劝止。
strings.vo.03: 两年后，阿骨打以两千五百人起兵，攻破宁江州，又在出河店大败辽军。
strings.vo.04: 次年正月，他即皇帝位，国号金。冬天，天祚帝亲征，号称七十万。
strings.scene.liaojin.hubudagang.fork.prompt: 护步答冈——依《金史》直书，还是听野史「海东青」？
strings.scene.liaojin.hubudagang.canon.intro: 天庆四年，宁江州。阿骨打会集各部两千五百人，在涞流水誓师。辽军还以为这只是边地小部的骚扰。
strings.scene.liaojin.hubudagang.end.canon: 辽军大败。阿骨打乘胜攻辽，十年之后，辽亡于金。
strings.scene.liaojin.hubudagang.legend.disclaim: 以下取自《契丹国志》卷二十六“诸蕃记·女真国”的说法（旧题南宋叶隆礼撰，私家史书），与《辽史》《金史》的叙述侧重不同；所记银牌天使之扰，正史不详，姑作野史线。
strings.scene.liaojin.hubudagang.legend.intro: 私家史书说：辽人年年向女真索取一种名为海东青的猎鹰，又派银牌使者到女真各部，横征暴敛，女真人怨恨日深。
strings.scene.liaojin.hubudagang.end.legend: 怨恨积成了起兵的理由。私家史书汇回正史：护步答冈之战。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

shots.vo: 辽天庆二年春，天祚帝在混同江钓鱼，设头鱼宴，令女真诸部酋长依次起舞。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–9 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：河水；飞白题字「雪」｜动作：混同江，冬季的冰面｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；留白为雪，枯笔点出雪片；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：草原风｜屏幕文字：片名「护步答冈」竖排书法与朱印「收国」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「辽天庆二年春，天祚帝在混同江钓鱼，设头鱼宴，令女真诸部酋长依次起舞。」

narration: 辽天庆二年春，天祚帝在混同江钓鱼，设头鱼宴，令女真诸部酋长依次起舞。
阿骨打端坐不动，推辞不能。天祚帝欲杀之，被近臣劝止。
两年后，阿骨打以两千五百人起兵，攻破宁江州，又在出河店大败辽军。
次年正月，他即皇帝位，国号金。冬天，天祚帝亲征，号称七十万。
两万金兵，在护步答冈——
辽军大败。阿骨打乘胜攻辽，十年之后，辽亡于金。

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 52 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

时代与场景：辽 · 西夏 · 金 · 辽天庆四年至五年，金收国元年（1114—1115 年）。草原毡帐、捺钵营地、城塞、雪原。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Liao, Western Xia and Jin (907–1234) · Hubudagang: Aguda Rises in Revolt (「护步答冈」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 52 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Setting: Liao, Western Xia and Jin (907–1234), 1114 CE–1115 CE — steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields.

Characters:
- Wanyan Aguda (完颜阿骨打) — ruler, Jin (Jurchen); Jurchen dress: braids, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, sable hat; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Liao Tianzuodi (辽天祚帝) — ruler, Liao (Khitan); Khitan dress: shaved crown, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, leather boots; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Wanyan Wuqimai (完颜吴乞买) — royal / consort, Jin (Jurchen); Jurchen dress: braids, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, sable hat; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Wanyan Zonghan (完颜宗翰) — general, Jin (Jurchen); Jurchen dress: braids, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, sable hat; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Yelü Zhangnu (耶律章奴) — general, Liao (Khitan); Khitan dress: shaved crown, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, leather boots; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–9 s, 9 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river; dry-brush calligraphy 「雪」 | Action: Winter ice on the Huntong River | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; blank paper as snow, dry-brush flakes; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: steppe wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「护步答冈」 with vermilion seal 「收国」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「辽天庆二年春，天祚帝在混同江钓鱼，设头鱼宴，令女真诸部酋长依次起舞。」
Shot 2 (9–16 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Liao Tianzuodi, Wanyan Aguda, fire (splashed ink) | Action: The Head-Fish Feast: the chiefs dance one by one | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; flat black flame silhouettes with a single vermilion core; heat-haze and smoke distortion | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: clinking cups | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「阿骨打端坐不动，推辞不能。天祚帝欲杀之，被近臣劝止。」
Shot 3 (16–25 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Wanyan Aguda, cavalry, banners | Action: Ningjiang: two thousand five hundred horsemen rise | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; ink spatters where hooves strike; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「两年后，阿骨打以两千五百人起兵，攻破宁江州，又在出河店大败辽军。」
Shot 4 (25–33 s, 8 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Liao Tianzuodi, army ranks, forest of spears | Action: The Liao emperor leads his army in person, camps stretching for miles | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: distant drums | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「次年正月，他即皇帝位，国号金。冬天，天祚帝亲征，号称七十万。」
Shot 5 (33–39 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: cavalry; dry-brush calligraphy 「冲阵」 | Action: Hubudagang | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; ink spatters where hooves strike; vignette closing in from the corners; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: horn | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「两万金兵，在护步答冈——」
Shot 6 (39–46 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: The Liao army is crushed; Aguda presses on, and within ten years Liao falls to Jin. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「辽军大败。阿骨打乘胜攻辽，十年之后，辽亡于金。」
Shot 7 (46–52 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「收国」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

Sound: Music: hujia reed pipe, bleak frontier mood, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: steppe wind, camp drums, distant battle, lingering wind after battle; SFX: clinking cups, hoofbeats, distant drums, horn; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「护步答冈」, subtitle 「阿骨打起兵」, vermilion seal 「收国」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, detailed faces, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets

strings.scene.liaojin.dashi.title: 虎思斡耳朵
strings.scene.liaojin.dashi.subtitle: 耶律大石建西辽
strings.vo.01: 耶律大石是辽太祖的八世孙，通契丹与汉文字，中过进士，官至林牙。金军南下，辽帝天祚逃入夹山。
strings.vo.02: 保大四年，大石与天祚帝意见不合，率领铁骑二百人连夜北走，到了漠北的可敦城。
strings.vo.03: 他召集七州十八部的首领，说：我们祖宗创业艰难，如今金人侵逼，我要借诸部之力，恢复故国。
strings.vo.04: 此后他率众西行，越过天山，在叶密立筑城，称菊儿汗，史称西辽。
strings.vo.05: 十几年后，在撒马尔罕以北的卡特万草原上——
strings.scene.liaojin.dashi.quote: 我祖宗艰难创业，历世九主，历年二百。
strings.scene.liaojin.dashi.fork.prompt: 虎思斡耳朵——依《辽史》直书，还是听欧洲传说「约翰长老」？
strings.anchor.beizou: 耶律大石率二百骑北走可敦城
strings.anchor.katewan: 卡特万之战，大败塞尔柱联军
strings.scene.liaojin.dashi.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《辽史·天祚皇帝纪》附西辽事所载
strings.scene.liaojin.dashi.canon.intro: 辽亡了，可是契丹人的王朝在西边又延续了八十多年。带队的是一个进士出身的宗室。
strings.scene.liaojin.dashi.end.canon: 卡特万一战，塞尔柱苏丹桑贾尔大败，西辽成为中亚霸主。西辽传国近九十年，1218 年为蒙古所灭。
strings.scene.liaojin.dashi.pick.legend: 欧洲传说 · 约翰长老
strings.scene.liaojin.dashi.legend.disclaimer: 以下取十二世纪欧洲流传的“约翰长老”（Prester John）传说：一一四五年，德意志史家弗赖辛的奥托在其编年史中记下叙利亚主教于格的报告，说东方有一位信基督教的祭司王约翰，大败波斯人。后世学者多认为，这个传说的原型之一就是卡特万之战中击败塞尔柱的耶律大石。这是欧洲人的想象与传闻。
strings.scene.liaojin.dashi.legend.intro: 消息传到了耶路撒冷：遥远的东方有一位国王，打败了波斯的苏丹，他的军队正要西来，与十字军会合。
strings.scene.liaojin.dashi.end.legend: 欧洲人盼来的祭司王始终没有出现，西辽的骑兵也没有继续西进。

画风：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）——大块黑色剪影与平涂灰阶，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白；少纹理、少装饰；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：2×2 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 战马（奔马侧影，鬃尾飞扬，四蹄腾空）；2. 旌旗（高杆大旗，旗面被风鼓起，穗带飘动）。
第 2 行：3. 角弓与箭（弯弓与箭矢，弓弦紧绷）；4. 留空。
排版参考尺寸：1024×1024 像素，每格按 512×512 切分；实际生成尺寸以所用服务返回值为准，裁切前须确认比例与透明通道。只有墨线与墨块，不加任何文字、书法、印章、边框、网格线、水印。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 辽 · 西夏 · 金 · 辽保大四年至西辽康国八年（1124—1141 年）。草原毡帐、捺钵营地、城塞、雪原。
setting.en: Liao, Western Xia and Jin (907–1234), 1124 CE–1141 CE — steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields.

characters.name: 耶律大石
characters.zh: 耶律大石（西辽·辽宗室、林牙，西辽德宗）：契丹装束：髡发、左衽窄袖袍、皮靴；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；辽亡前率部西行，建西辽，称菊儿汗
characters.en: Yelü Dashi (耶律大石) — ruler, Western Liao; Khitan dress: shaved crown, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, leather boots; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 耶律延禧
characters.zh: 耶律延禧（辽·辽天祚帝）：契丹装束：髡发、左衽窄袖袍、皮靴；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；困于夹山，与大石不合
characters.en: Yelü Yanxi (耶律延禧) — ruler, Liao (Khitan); Khitan dress: shaved crown, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, leather boots; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 七州十八部
characters.zh: 七州十八部（西辽·可敦城周边诸部）：契丹装束：髡发、左衽窄袖袍、皮靴；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；会于可敦城，奉大石为主
characters.en: Qi Zhoushibabu (七州十八部) — commoner, Western Liao; Khitan dress: shaved crown, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, leather boots; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 桑贾尔
characters.zh: 桑贾尔（塞尔柱·塞尔柱苏丹）：中亚伊斯兰装束：缠头巾、长袍、弯刀；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；卡特万之战被大石击败
characters.en: Sanjar (桑贾尔) — ruler, Seljuk; Central Asian Islamic dress: turban, long robe, scimitar; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 耶律大石是辽太祖的八世孙，通契丹与汉文字，中过进士，官至林牙。金军南下，辽帝天祚逃入夹山。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–11 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：近山与地面、营帐；主体：耶律延禧、耶律大石｜动作：夹山中，辽的皇帝与林牙争执不下｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：片名「虎思斡耳朵」竖排书法与朱印「西辽」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「耶律大石是辽太祖的八世孙，通契丹与汉文字，中过进士，官至林牙。金军南下，辽帝天祚逃入夹山。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–11 s, 11 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: near hills and ground, army tents; subject: Yelü Yanxi, Yelü Dashi | Action: In the Jia mountains the Liao emperor and the scholar-general argue | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: silence | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「虎思斡耳朵」 with vermilion seal 「西辽」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「耶律大石是辽太祖的八世孙，通契丹与汉文字，中过进士，官至林牙。金军南下，辽帝天祚逃入夹山。」

shots.vo: 保大四年，大石与天祚帝意见不合，率领铁骑二百人连夜北走，到了漠北的可敦城。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（11–21 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：远景：远山、月；主体：骑兵｜动作：二百铁骑趁夜离营，向北而去｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；月轮留白，四周淡墨烘染；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「保大四年，大石与天祚帝意见不合，率领铁骑二百人连夜北走，到了漠北的可敦城。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (11–21 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: distant mountains, moon; subject: cavalry | Action: Two hundred horsemen slip away north by night | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; ink spatters where hooves strike; moon left blank with pale wash around it; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「保大四年，大石与天祚帝意见不合，率领铁骑二百人连夜北走，到了漠北的可敦城。」

shots.vo: 他召集七州十八部的首领，说：我们祖宗创业艰难，如今金人侵逼，我要借诸部之力，恢复故国。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（21–32 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：七州十八部、旌旗、众人｜动作：可敦城，七州十八部的首领齐集帐下｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白｜声音：环境：人群低语；音效：战鼓｜屏幕文字：引文「我祖宗艰难创业，历世九主，历年二百。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他召集七州十八部的首领，说：我们祖宗创业艰难，如今金人侵逼，我要借诸部之力，恢复故国。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (21–32 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Qi Zhoushibabu, banners, crowd | Action: At Kedun the chiefs of seven prefectures and eighteen tribes gather | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: war drums | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「我祖宗艰难创业，历世九主，历年二百。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他召集七州十八部的首领，说：我们祖宗创业艰难，如今金人侵逼，我要借诸部之力，恢复故国。」

shots.vo: 此后他率众西行，越过天山，在叶密立筑城，称菊儿汗，史称西辽。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（32–40 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：远景：远山；中景：沙；主体：骑兵｜动作：大军越过天山，驼队连绵不绝｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；干笔擦出沙地；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：驼铃｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「此后他率众西行，越过天山，在叶密立筑城，称菊儿汗，史称西辽。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (32–40 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: sand; subject: cavalry | Action: The army crosses the Tianshan with endless camel trains | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; dry-brush scumbled sand; ink spatters where hooves strike; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: camel bells | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「此后他率众西行，越过天山，在叶密立筑城，称菊儿汗，史称西辽。」

shots.vo: 十几年后，在撒马尔罕以北的卡特万草原上——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（40–46 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：远景：远山；主体：骑兵、军阵、长兵如林；飞白题字「西辽」｜动作：卡特万的草原上，契丹骑兵三路合击｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；四角暗角收拢；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：战鼓｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「十几年后，在撒马尔罕以北的卡特万草原上——」

shots.vo: 卡特万一战，塞尔柱苏丹桑贾尔大败，西辽成为中亚霸主。西辽传国近九十年，1218 年为蒙古所灭。

narration: 耶律大石是辽太祖的八世孙，通契丹与汉文字，中过进士，官至林牙。金军南下，辽帝天祚逃入夹山。
保大四年，大石与天祚帝意见不合，率领铁骑二百人连夜北走，到了漠北的可敦城。
他召集七州十八部的首领，说：我们祖宗创业艰难，如今金人侵逼，我要借诸部之力，恢复故国。
此后他率众西行，越过天山，在叶密立筑城，称菊儿汗，史称西辽。
十几年后，在撒马尔罕以北的卡特万草原上——
卡特万一战，塞尔柱苏丹桑贾尔大败，西辽成为中亚霸主。西辽传国近九十年，1218 年为蒙古所灭。
我祖宗艰难创业，历世九主，历年二百。

[Ink-wash video prompt] Liao, Western Xia and Jin (907–1234) · Balasagun: Yelü Dashi Founds the Western Liao (「虎思斡耳朵」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 64 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Setting: Liao, Western Xia and Jin (907–1234), 1124 CE–1141 CE — steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields.

Characters:
- Yelü Dashi (耶律大石) — ruler, Western Liao; Khitan dress: shaved crown, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, leather boots; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Yelü Yanxi (耶律延禧) — ruler, Liao (Khitan); Khitan dress: shaved crown, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, leather boots; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Qi Zhoushibabu (七州十八部) — commoner, Western Liao; Khitan dress: shaved crown, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, leather boots; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Sanjar (桑贾尔) — ruler, Seljuk; Central Asian Islamic dress: turban, long robe, scimitar; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

strings.scene.liaojin.wushan.title: 立马吴山
strings.scene.liaojin.wushan.subtitle: 海陵南征
strings.vo.01: 海陵王完颜亮弑熙宗自立，迁都燕京，又营建汴京，一心要一统天下。
strings.vo.02: 正隆六年九月，他不顾群臣劝阻，亲率大军分道南下，号称百万。
strings.vo.03: 他刚走，东京留守完颜雍就在辽阳即位，改元大定。海陵却不肯回师，要先渡江灭宋。
strings.vo.04: 十一月，金军在采石渡江，被虞允文督率的宋军击退。海陵转往扬州，限三日内从瓜洲渡江，不渡者斩。
strings.vo.05: 夜里，营中忽然响起了箭声——
strings.scene.liaojin.wushan.fork.prompt: 立马吴山——依《金史》直书，还是听笔记「吴山题诗」？
strings.scene.liaojin.wushan.canon.intro: 正隆六年秋，燕京。宫中新挂起一面软壁，画的是临安的湖山城郭。吴山顶上，画着一个策马的人。
strings.scene.liaojin.wushan.end.canon: 完颜元宜等率兵攻入海陵营帐，海陵中箭，被缢杀。金军北还，宋金复议和。海陵死后被降为海陵郡王，后又降为庶人。
strings.scene.liaojin.wushan.legend.disclaimer: 以下取南宋罗大经《鹤林玉露》丙编卷一与《大金国志》卷十四：前者说海陵闻柳永《望海潮》中“三秋桂子，十里荷花”而起渡江之志；后者说他命画工绘临安湖山，图己像策马吴山绝顶并题诗。两书皆非正史，《大金国志》旧题宇文懋昭撰，成书有争议。
strings.scene.liaojin.wushan.legend.intro: 笔记说：海陵听人唱起柳永写杭州的词，羡慕那里的桂子与荷花。他派使臣南下贺正旦，暗中带了画工。
strings.scene.liaojin.wushan.end.legend: 吴山顶上的画像没有变成真的。笔记与正史在瓜洲渡口。
strings.scene.liaojin.wushan.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若海陵闻东京之变即回师（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 辽 · 西夏 · 金 · 金正隆六年十一月，宋绍兴三十一年（1161 年十一月）。草原毡帐、捺钵营地、城塞、雪原。
setting.en: Liao, Western Xia and Jin (907–1234), 1161 CE — steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields.

shots.vo: 海陵王完颜亮弑熙宗自立，迁都燕京，又营建汴京，一心要一统天下。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：完颜亮、山水｜动作：燕京宫中，一幅临安湖山的软壁｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：片名「立马吴山」竖排书法与朱印「吴山」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「海陵王完颜亮弑熙宗自立，迁都燕京，又营建汴京，一心要一统天下。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Wanyan Liang, landscape | Action: A painted screen of Lin'an's lakes and hills in the Yanjing palace | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「立马吴山」 with vermilion seal 「吴山」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「海陵王完颜亮弑熙宗自立，迁都燕京，又营建汴京，一心要一统天下。」

shots.vo: 正隆六年九月，他不顾群臣劝阻，亲率大军分道南下，号称百万。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（8–16 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：主体：军阵、长兵如林、骑兵、旌旗｜动作：金军分道南下｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；枯笔竖线密如森林；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「正隆六年九月，他不顾群臣劝阻，亲率大军分道南下，号称百万。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (8–16 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: army ranks, forest of spears, cavalry, banners | Action: Jin armies march south by several routes | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「正隆六年九月，他不顾群臣劝阻，亲率大军分道南下，号称百万。」

shots.vo: 他刚走，东京留守完颜雍就在辽阳即位，改元大定。海陵却不肯回师，要先渡江灭宋。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（16–26 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、卷轴；主体：完颜雍｜动作：东京传来消息：完颜雍已即位｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他刚走，东京留守完颜雍就在辽阳即位，改元大定。海陵却不肯回师，要先渡江灭宋。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (16–26 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, scroll; subject: Wanyan Yong | Action: News from the east: Wanyan Yong has taken the throne | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他刚走，东京留守完颜雍就在辽阳即位，改元大定。海陵却不肯回师，要先渡江灭宋。」

shots.vo: 十一月，金军在采石渡江，被虞允文督率的宋军击退。海陵转往扬州，限三日内从瓜洲渡江，不渡者斩。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（26–37 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：河水、舟、烟；主体：火｜动作：采石江面，金军渡江受挫｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾；水墨流动晕染；热浪与烟气扭曲｜声音：环境：海浪；音效：烈火｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「十一月，金军在采石渡江，被虞允文督率的宋军击退。海陵转往扬州，限三日内从瓜洲渡江，不渡者斩。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (26–37 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: river, boat, smoke; subject: fire (splashed ink) | Action: At Caishi the Jin crossing is beaten back | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; heat-haze and smoke distortion | Sound: ambience: sea waves; SFX: roaring fire | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「十一月，金军在采石渡江，被虞允文督率的宋军击退。海陵转往扬州，限三日内从瓜洲渡江，不渡者斩。」

shots.vo: 夜里，营中忽然响起了箭声——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（37–43 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：完颜元宜、火；飞白题字「瓜洲」｜动作：瓜洲渡口，龟山寺中箭雨｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白；平涂黑焰剪影，焰心一抹朱红；四角暗角收拢；热浪与烟气扭曲；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：放箭｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「夜里，营中忽然响起了箭声——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (37–43 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Wanyan Yuanyi, fire (splashed ink); dry-brush calligraphy 「瓜洲」 | Action: A rain of arrows at the temple by Guazhou ferry | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; flat black flame silhouettes with a single vermilion core; vignette closing in from the corners; heat-haze and smoke distortion; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: arrow release | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「夜里，营中忽然响起了箭声——」

shots.vo: 完颜元宜等率兵攻入海陵营帐，海陵中箭，被缢杀。金军北还，宋金复议和。海陵死后被降为海陵郡王，后又降为庶人。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（43–56 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：完颜元宜｜动作：正史结局：完颜元宜等率兵攻入海陵营帐，海陵中箭，被缢杀。金军北还，宋金复议和。海陵死后被降为海陵郡王，后又降为庶人。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「完颜元宜等率兵攻入海陵营帐，海陵中箭，被缢杀。金军北还，宋金复议和。海陵死后被降为海陵郡王，后又降为庶人。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (43–56 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Wanyan Yuanyi | Action: Canonical outcome: Hailing's own officers storm his tent and kill him; Jin withdraws, peace is renewed, and he is posthumously demoted to commoner. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「完颜元宜等率兵攻入海陵营帐，海陵中箭，被缢杀。金军北还，宋金复议和。海陵死后被降为海陵郡王，后又降为庶人。」

shots.zh: 镜头 7（56–62 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文；右下角朱印「吴山」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处
shots.en: Shot 7 (56–62 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「吴山」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

sound.zh: 背景乐：胡笳，边塞悲凉，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：宫殿回响、远处厮杀声、寂静室内、海浪、夜风；音效：衣袂摩挲、马蹄声、竹简翻动、烈火、放箭；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: hujia reed pipe, bleak frontier mood, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: palace hall reverb, distant battle, quiet room tone, sea waves, night wind; SFX: rustling silk, hoofbeats, bamboo slips rustling, roaring fire, arrow release; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

narration: 海陵王完颜亮弑熙宗自立，迁都燕京，又营建汴京，一心要一统天下。
正隆六年九月，他不顾群臣劝阻，亲率大军分道南下，号称百万。
他刚走，东京留守完颜雍就在辽阳即位，改元大定。海陵却不肯回师，要先渡江灭宋。
十一月，金军在采石渡江，被虞允文督率的宋军击退。海陵转往扬州，限三日内从瓜洲渡江，不渡者斩。
夜里，营中忽然响起了箭声——
完颜元宜等率兵攻入海陵营帐，海陵中箭，被缢杀。金军北还，宋金复议和。海陵死后被降为海陵郡王，后又降为庶人。

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 62 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

时代与场景：辽 · 西夏 · 金 · 金正隆六年十一月，宋绍兴三十一年（1161 年十一月）。草原毡帐、捺钵营地、城塞、雪原。

人物：
- 完颜亮（金·海陵王）：女真装束：辫发、左衽窄袖袍、貂帽；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；弑熙宗自立，迁都燕京，倾国南征
- 完颜雍（金·东京留守）：女真装束：辫发、左衽窄袖袍、貂帽；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；海陵南征时在东京辽阳即位
- 完颜元宜（金·浙西道都统制）：女真装束：辫发、左衽窄袖袍、貂帽；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；瓜洲兵变弑海陵

- 虞允文（宋·督视府参谋军事）：契丹髡发、左衽窄袖袍与皮靴；党项秃发；女真辫发；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；采石督战，挫败金军渡江

镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：完颜亮、山水｜动作：燕京宫中，一幅临安湖山的软壁｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：片名「立马吴山」竖排书法与朱印「吴山」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「海陵王完颜亮弑熙宗自立，迁都燕京，又营建汴京，一心要一统天下。」
